items.title: 17.5 Solubility of Sulphates and Hydroxides (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the solubility of Group 2 sulphates and hydroxides (PDF 10-11).

blocks.text: Kisi ionic compound ki paani mein hall pazeeri do tawanai tabdeeliyon ke tawazun par munhasir hai.

items: Enthalpy of hydration: gaseous ions ke paani ke molecules mein ghir kar khinchne par nikalne wali tawanai; hamesha exothermic. Zyada charge density wale chhote ions paani ko zyada kheenchte aur zyada manfi qeemat dete hain; group mein neeche ions bare hone se yeh kam manfi hoti hai.

Lattice enthalpy: aik mole ionic thos ko gaseous ions mein todne ke liye darkaar tawanai; hamesha endothermic. Kashish ki quwwat jitni zyada ho yeh utni bari hai, jo ions ke charge aur size par munhasir hai: jab cation aur anion ka size milta julta ho to lattice energy zyada, aur jab aik ion doosre se kaheen bara ho to kam hoti hai.

blocks.text: Enthalpy of solution thos ionic maadde ke ghulne par kul tawanai tabdeeli hai; zyada manfi (ya kam musbat) qeemat aam taur par zyada hall pazeeri ke haq mein hai.

blocks.alt: Kitab ke Table 17.4 se log paimane par do bar charts. Hydroxides: Mg(OH)2 2 x 10^-5, Ca(OH)2 1.5 x 10^-3, Sr(OH)2 3.4 x 10^-3 aur Ba(OH)2 1.5 x 10^-2 mol fi 100 g paani, group mein neeche barhte. Sulphates: MgSO4 0.183, CaSO4 4.66 x 10^-3, SrSO4 7.11 x 10^-5 aur BaSO4 9.43 x 10^-7, group mein neeche ghat'te.
blocks.caption: Group 2 hydroxides aur sulphates ki hall pazeeri ke rujhan (Figure 17.4 aur Table 17.4 ke mutabiq asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Group 2 compounds ki hall pazeeri (solubility) ulte rujhan dikhati hai. Hydroxides group mein neeche zyada ghulte hain: magnesium hydroxide kam ghulta, barium hydroxide kaafi ghulta hai. Sulphates group mein neeche kam ghulte hain: magnesium sulphate ghulta jab ke barium sulphate taqreeban nahi ghulta. Har rujhan is se aata hai ke cation bara hone par lattice enthalpy aur hydration enthalpy kaise badalti hain, aur bars log paimane par hain kyunke qeematein das ki chhe taaqaton tak phaili hain.

items: Hydroxides: hall pazeeri group mein neeche barhti (Mg(OH)2 thora, Ba(OH)2 kaafi ghulta). Hydration aur lattice dono enthalpies neeche ghat'ti hain, lekin chhote hydroxide ion ke liye lattice enthalpy ki kami zyada hai, is liye ghulna aasan hota hai.

Sulphates: hall pazeeri neeche ghat'ti (MgSO4 ghulta, BaSO4 nahi ghulta). Sulphate ion bara hai, is liye cation bara hone par lattice enthalpy kam badalti jab ke hydration enthalpy zyada ghat'ti hai; ghulna mushkil hota hai.

blocks.caption: 298 K par Group 2 hydroxides aur sulphates ki hall pazeeri, mol fi 100 g paani (kitab ka Table 17.4)

blocks.prompt: Kaun zyada ghulta hai, Sr(OH)2 ya Mg(OH)2? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sr(OH)2 (3.4 x 10^-3 ke muqable mein 2 x 10^-5 mol/100 g): group mein neeche hydroxides ki lattice enthalpy hydration enthalpy se zyada ghat'ti hai, is liye aasani se ghulte hain.

items: Hall pazeeri lattice enthalpy aur hydration enthalpy ke muqable par munhasir.
Hydroxides: neeche zyada ghulte; sulphates: neeche kam ghulte.
